name: Timeline

description.zh: 按时间或流程顺序展示活动记录和关键里程碑。
description.en: Display chronological activity logs or project milestones.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

`Timeline` 默认纵向排列，用 `Current`（从 0 开始的索引）或 `CurrentID`（优先）标记当前进度位置。`Reverse` 会反转已完成与未完成的视觉方向，但不改变条目本身顺序；`Time` 直接接收应用格式化好的日期文字。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 调整「当前步骤」或指定 `CurrentID`，再切换「反向进度」和横向/纵向布局。
2. 开启「点击后更新当前项」，用鼠标或键盘点击条目更新进度。
3. 尝试显示头像和自定义日期文字样式。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

`Timeline` is vertical by default. Mark progress with `Current` (0-based index) or `CurrentID` (takes priority). `Reverse` flips progress highlighting without reordering items; pass pre-formatted strings to `Time`.

### Try the preview

1. Change `Current` or `Current item ID`, then toggle `Reverse progress` and horizontal layout.
2. Enable `Follow selection` and click or keyboard-select items to move the active marker.
3. Try avatars and custom date styles.

note.zh:
- 点击触发 `OnSelect` 不会自动推进进度，需在回调中更新状态。
- `CurrentID` 未匹配任何条目时不会回退到 `Current`；无效索引不高亮任何项。
- 单项 `Color` 覆盖和 `Content` 为 Go 原生扩展，尺寸支持 `XS`–`XL` 五档。
note.en:
- `OnSelect` does not update progress automatically—update your state inside the callback.
- An unmatched `CurrentID` does not fall back to `Current`, and invalid indexes highlight nothing.
- Per-item `Color` and `Content` are Go-native extensions; sizes cover `XS`–`XL`.

name: Banner

description.zh: 在页面顶部或内容区展示醒目且可关闭的横幅通知。
description.en: Display a prominent, dismissible banner notice across a page.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

用应用保存的 `*bool` 控制横幅显示与隐藏；传入该状态时默认自带关闭按钮（可用 `CloseButton: nui.Set(false)` 隐藏）。`OnSelect` 处理整条横幅的点击，与 `Actions` 里的操作按钮互不干扰。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 分别点击横幅本体和 `Release notes` 按钮，观察各自独立的计数。
2. 自定义关闭按钮样式，关闭后再重新显示。
3. 调整标题长度与颜色，体验单行省略及响应式居中对齐。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Control visibility with an app-owned `*bool`—providing it shows a close button by default (hide with `CloseButton: nui.Set(false)`). `OnSelect` handles clicking the banner itself independently of buttons in `Actions`.

### Try the preview

1. Click the banner and the `Release notes` button separately to watch each counter.
2. Customize the close button, dismiss the banner, and reopen it.
3. Try longer titles and different colors to inspect single-line truncation.

note.zh:
- 横幅正文保持单行显示：窗口宽于 1024 DIP 时居中对齐，较窄时靠起点对齐。
- 未绑定开关状态时默认无关闭按钮；若手动开启，则使用组件内部状态，卸载后会重置。
- 跨启动记住「不再提示」以及页面跳转需由应用自行实现。
note.en:
- Banner content stays on one line, centered at window widths ≥ 1024 DIP and start-aligned below.
- Without a bound `*bool`, no close button is shown by default; enabling it manually uses local state that resets on unmount.
- Persisting dismissal across launches and handling navigation belong to your app.

name: Error

description.zh: 清晰展示错误状态与原因，并提供重试或返回操作。
description.en: Present an error status and reason with a retry or recovery action.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

`ErrorView` 用于展示状态码 `Status`、标题 `Title` 和说明 `Description`。传入 `OnRetry` 时会自动显示默认重试按钮（可通过 `Retry` 定制样式，或用 `Clear: nui.Set(false)` 隐藏）；需要多个按钮时用 `Actions` 替换操作区。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 修改状态码、标题和说明；试试清空标题，或让说明与标题相同，观察自动去重效果。
2. 对比默认重试按钮、自定义按钮以及完全替换操作区（`Actions`）。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

`ErrorView` displays a `Status` code, `Title`, and `Description`. Passing `OnRetry` shows a default retry button (customize via `Retry` or hide with `Clear: nui.Set(false)`); use `Actions` to replace the action area.

### Try the preview

1. Edit the status, title, and description—try clearing the title or duplicating it to see deduplication.
2. Compare the default button, customized retry button, and replaced `Actions`.

note.zh:
- 标题字号随窗口宽度自适应（小于 640 DIP 为 36 DIP，否则为 48 DIP），组件默认采用嵌入式内边距，不会强行撑满整个窗口。
- 组件仅负责展示与回调，清理错误状态、重新请求或页面跳转由应用在 `OnRetry` / `Actions` 中处理。
note.en:
- The title scales with window width (36 DIP below 640 DIP, 48 DIP otherwise), and the view uses embedded padding rather than forcing full-window height.
- Clearing errors, retrying requests, and navigating are handled by your app in `OnRetry` or `Actions`.

controls.default: This example does not make network requests.

name: Form

description.zh: 统一校验多个表单字段，支持同步与异步提交。
description.en: Validate multiple form fields together with synchronous or async submission.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

在应用状态中保存 `FormState`，内部每个字段通过 `FormField.Name` 和 `Value` 注册。`Validate` 返回按字段名索引的错误信息（空字符串键表示表单级全局错误）；校验通过后触发 `OnSubmit`，失败时触发一次 `OnError`。提交按钮调用 `form.Submit()` 发起提交流程。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 清空项目名称并点击 `Save project`，观察错误提示与自动聚焦；填好名称后重新保存。
2. 开启「模拟异步提交」后保存：表单控件默认自动禁用且防止重复提交，点击 `Complete request` 或 `Cancel request` 结束。
3. 关闭「提交中禁用」，在提交期间修改名称后再完成请求，验证过期结果会被自动拒绝。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Keep a `FormState` in app state and register fields via `FormField.Name` and `Value`. `Validate` returns errors keyed by field name (use `""` for a form-wide error). Valid submits call `OnSubmit`; invalid submits call `OnError` once. Trigger submission with `form.Submit()`.

### Try the preview

1. Leave the project name blank and click `Save project` to see validation and error focus, then fill it in and save.
2. Enable `Simulated async submission` and save: controls disable by default and duplicate submits are blocked until you complete or cancel.
3. Turn off `Disable while submitting`, edit the name mid-request, and complete it to confirm stale results are rejected.

note.zh:
- 异步提交的结果需在 UI 线程调用 `CompleteAsync` 回传；若期间字段值或状态发生变化，旧票据会被自动忽略。
- 页面卸载或关闭窗口前请调用 `Cancel`，并取消正在进行的后台 I/O。
- `FormField.Required` 仅显示星号，不替代 `Validate`；嵌套 `Form` 不会自动合并校验。
note.en:
- Deliver async results on the UI thread via `CompleteAsync`; stale tickets are rejected if field values or state changed.
- Call `Cancel` before unmounting or closing a window, and cancel your underlying I/O.
- `FormField.Required` only displays an asterisk and does not validate; nested forms do not merge validation automatically.

name: InputNumber

description.zh: 输入数字，或通过加减按钮和快捷键按步长调整。
description.en: Type a number or step it with increment/decrement buttons and keys.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

用 `Optional[float64]` 区分「未填」与 `0`，`NumberState` 保存未完成输入草稿。有效数字会实时同步到模型，按 `Enter` 会按步长对齐或恢复到最后有效值（组件默认不设上下界，本例限定为 0–100）。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 清空输入框后点击加减按钮，观察先跳到「空值起始值」，再按步长增减。
2. 聚焦输入框后试试上下方向键、`PageUp`/`PageDown`（±10 步）、`Home`/`End`（边界）以及鼠标滚轮。
3. 切换按钮方向、隐藏或禁用单个按钮，以及体验「允许输入超出范围的值」。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Use `Optional[float64]` to distinguish empty from `0`, and `NumberState` to hold unfinished text. Valid edits update the model immediately; `Enter` snaps to `Step` or restores the last valid value (no default bounds; this demo uses 0–100).

### Try the preview

1. Clear the input and step once to jump to `Starting value`, then step again by `Step`.
2. Focus the input and test Up/Down, `PageUp`/`PageDown` (10 steps), `Home`/`End` (bounds), and mouse wheel scrolling.
3. Try changing orientation, hiding/disabling step buttons, and toggling `Allow out-of-range input`.

note.zh:
- `StepSnapping`、`FocusOnChange` 和鼠标滚轮默认开启；长按加减按钮支持连续增减。
- `AllowInvalid` 仅允许输入越界的有限数值，仍拒绝非法文字、`NaN` 和 `Inf`。
- 仅解析标准 ASCII 小数与科学记数法，不支持货币或地区千分位格式；失焦时保留草稿。
note.en:
- `StepSnapping`, `FocusOnChange`, and mouse wheel stepping are on by default; hold step buttons to repeat.
- `AllowInvalid` permits finite out-of-range numbers while still rejecting invalid text, `NaN`, and `Inf`.
- Parses ASCII decimal and scientific notation only (no currency or locale formatting); blur retains drafts.

name: InputTags

description.zh: 将输入的文字拆分为可移除的标签列表。
description.en: Turn typed or pasted text into removable tags.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

绑定 `*[]string` 保存标签列表，用 `TagsState.Query` 保存正在输入的文字，标签与输入框会在容器内自动换行。`ConvertValue` 用于规范化新增标签，`DisplayValue` 仅改变显示文案而不改变底层值。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 输入文字后按 `Enter` 或输入逗号添加标签；开启「粘贴添加」后可一次粘贴多项。
2. 光标位于输入框开头时，按一次 `Backspace` 选中最后一个标签，再按一次删除；左右键可在标签间切换。
3. 尝试「按 Tab 添加」「失焦添加」「允许重复」以及标签大小写转换开关。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Bind a `*[]string` for tags and use `TagsState.Query` for the active input draft; tags and editor wrap together. `ConvertValue` normalizes new values, while `DisplayValue` customizes display labels without changing underlying values.

### Try the preview

1. Type text and press `Enter` or a comma to add a tag; enable `Paste` to add multiple tags at once.
2. At the start of the draft, press `Backspace` once to select the last tag and again to delete it; use Left/Right arrows to move between tags.
3. Try `Add on Tab`, `Add on blur`, `Allow duplicates`, and value/label casing options.

note.zh:
- 去重区分大小写，并在 `ConvertValue` 转换之后执行；`MaxTags <= 0` 不限数量，`MaxLength` 按 UTF-16 单元限制草稿长度。
- 批量粘贴成功时只触发一次 `OnTagsChange`，重复或超限的候选会被拒绝，不会作为普通文字插入。
- 仅支持字符串切片，不提供对象模型或正则表达式分隔符。
note.en:
- Deduplication is case-sensitive and runs after `ConvertValue`. `MaxTags <= 0` is unlimited; `MaxLength` limits draft UTF-16 units.
- Batch paste emits `OnTagsChange` once; duplicate or over-limit items are rejected instead of inserted as plain text.
- Supports string slices only (no object models or regex delimiters).

name: PinInput

description.zh: 按格输入验证码或固定长度的短代码。
description.en: Enter a verification code or fixed-length short code cell by cell.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

`PinInput` 绑定 `*string`，底层使用单个真实文本编辑器（`Tab` 只停靠一次），默认 5 格。开启 `Numeric` 仅接受 ASCII 数字；当用户输入达到指定长度时触发 `OnComplete`。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 输入或粘贴验证码，点击任意格子即可替换；方向键、选区和撤销均与普通输入框一致。
2. 调整「输入格数」「仅输入数字」和「每组格数」，观察分组分隔符与布局变化。
3. 切换「隐藏字符」（密码遮罩）或「只读」，查看界面显示与下方计数。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

`PinInput` binds a `*string` over one real text editor (a single `Tab` stop), defaulting to 5 cells. `Numeric` restricts input to ASCII digits, and `OnComplete` fires once user input reaches `Length`.

### Try the preview

1. Type or paste a code and click any cell to replace it; arrows, selection, and undo work natively.
2. Adjust `Input slots`, `Digits only`, and `Separator interval` to inspect grouping and layout.
3. Toggle `Mask characters` or `Read-only`.

note.zh:
- 格数范围 1–32（默认 5），按字符（rune）计数；`Separator` 与 `SeparatorEvery` 会自动合并去重。
- 外部修改 `Length` 或 `Numeric` 会静默规范化当前值，不触发用户输入回调。
- 不支持自动读取短信或浏览器 OTP 自动填充；如需主动聚焦请使用 `PinState.Handle`。
note.en:
- `Length` supports 1–32 runes (default 5); `Separator` and `SeparatorEvery` merge without duplicates.
- Changing `Length` or `Numeric` externally normalizes the value silently without firing input callbacks.
- SMS reading and browser OTP autofill are not available; manage focus with `PinState.Handle`.

name: InputRating

description.zh: 以星级图标选择整数评分。
description.en: Select a whole-number rating with star icons.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

`InputRating` 绑定 `*int`（`0` 表示未评分），`Max` 默认 5（支持 1–20）。支持方向键、`Home`/`End` 调整以及 `Space` 快捷选择或清空；`Clearable` 与 `Hoverable` 默认关闭。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 点击星标或用方向键评分，再开启「悬停预览」与「可清空」（点击当前分值或按 `Space` 清零）。
2. 切换「自定义两种图标」和「自定义图层颜色」，观察未选中底层图标与选中叠层的效果。
3. 切换「只读」「纵向」和「最大评分」，观察键盘焦点与上限变化。

### 缩放反馈

启用交互（User）或悬停星标（InputRating），可观察原生 AnimatePose 缩放：目标变化时可以构建一次，后续动画帧仅重绘。Motion.Transition 控制时长；零或负时长、减少动态效果及关闭动效模式立即显示最终大小。动画途中关闭动效会停止后续帧，同时保留焦点与激活行为。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

`InputRating` binds an `*int` (`0` means unrated) with `Max` defaulting to 5 (supports 1–20). Supports arrow keys, `Home`/`End`, and `Space` to select or clear. `Clearable` and `Hoverable` default to `false`.

### Try the preview

1. Click stars or use arrow keys, then try `Hover preview` and `Clearable` (click the active star or press `Space` to clear).
2. Toggle `Custom icon layers` and `Custom layer colors` to inspect the empty base and filled overlay.
3. Try `Read-only`, vertical orientation, and changing `Maximum`.

### Scale feedback

Enable interaction (User) or hover a star (InputRating). Scale feedback uses native AnimatePose: the target change can build once, while later animation ticks only paint. Motion.Transition controls duration; zero/negative duration, Reduced and Off show the final scale immediately. Disabling motion during a pose stops its remaining ticks without losing focus or activation.

note.zh:
- 仅支持整数评分，不提供半星步长或自定义每项内容构建器。
- 悬停预览不修改实际值也不触发 `OnChange`；只读模式保留 `Tab` 焦点但禁止编辑。
- 底层通过单焦点滑块语义实现（不同于网页版的单选组），校验和保存由应用负责。
note.en:
- Supports whole-number ratings only (no half-star steps or custom item builders).
- Hover preview does not mutate the value or emit `OnChange`; read-only keeps `Tab` focus while blocking edits.
- Uses a single focusable slider role natively (unlike web radio groups); validation and persistence belong to your app.

name: Listbox

description.zh: 在直接展开的列表中筛选并选择一项或多项。
description.en: Filter and select one or more items in an always-visible list.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

用 `[]string` 保存选中项 ID，`ListboxState` 保存搜索词、高亮项和滚动位置；列表中的每一项（含分组标题和分隔线）都必须有唯一 `ID`。开启 `Filter` 可内置筛选框，`Loading` 会显示加载图标并暂停选项操作。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 点击 `Go` 体验单选切换；开启「多选」后用方向键移动高亮，按 `Enter`/`Space` 勾选。
2. 在筛选框输入 `cafe`，观察匹配排序；选中 `Café` 时测试「阻止选择 Café」的 `PreventDefault` 拦截效果。
3. 点击 `Reorder options` 重排数据，确认选中项和高亮始终跟随稳定 ID。

### 显式提交数据

每个实例保留独立状态，在初始化、数据替换或异步结果被接受后调用 SetItems。提交后由状态持有描述符快照；修改原数据后需重新提交，nil 释放数据而保留选择与查询。渲染时传入选择状态和组件状态，不再传入数据切片。OnChange 无参数，每次已接受的用户选择变化通知一次；外部选择修改保持静默。Values() 显式复制有序选择。不变的视图构建不扫描全部候选项或选中值。

### 本地搜索执行

将“本地搜索执行”切换为 background 后在筛选框输入。默认 SearchAuto 对不超过 2,048 个候选项同步搜索，超过后使用后台工作线程；SearchImmediate 始终同步，SearchBackground 对非空本地查询始终在后台执行。首次归一化和匹配都在后台，后续查询复用未变的字段缓存。等待时显示加载状态，不能激活旧结果或创建值，查询仍可编辑。空查询和 ExternalFilter/IgnoreFilter 绕过本地匹配。查询、数据、配置变化以及关闭、卸载或窗口关闭会取消过期工作。每个实例和窗口保留独立状态，所有者销毁时调用 Close()，Searching() 表示本地等待状态。每个挂载搜索区域只保留一个活动工作线程及一个最新待执行请求。数据提交和完整匹配仍为 O(N)，不变的渲染仅构建可见行；应用回调和 UI 构建器仍在 UI 线程执行。浏览器预览的后台 goroutine 与 JavaScript 共享事件循环，按批次让出执行权，并非独立 Web Worker。复制的程序和预览都会清理搜索状态。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Store selected IDs in `SelectionState[string]` and keep query, highlight, and scroll state in `ListboxState`. Every item—including labels and separators—requires a unique `ID`. `Filter` adds a built-in search box; `Loading` shows a spinner and pauses item actions.

### Try the preview

1. Click `Go` to toggle selection; enable `Multiple`, move the highlight with arrows, and toggle with `Enter`/`Space`.
2. Search `cafe` to see match ranking, and test `Prevent Café selection` (`PreventDefault`).
3. Click `Reorder options` to verify selection and highlight follow stable IDs.

### Submitted data

Keep one state per instance and call SetItems during setup, data replacement, or accepted async completion. The setter owns its descriptors; resubmit after edits, and use nil to release the data without clearing selection or query. Render with the selection state and component state, without a slice argument. OnChange is parameterless and fires once per accepted user change. External selection mutations are silent; Values() explicitly copies the ordered selection. Unchanged builds do not scan all candidates or selected values.

### Local search execution

Try Local search execution = background and type into the filter. SearchAuto (default) searches at most 2,048 candidates immediately and uses a worker above that count; SearchImmediate always runs synchronously and SearchBackground always runs nonempty local queries in the background. Both first normalization and matching run there, with cached fields reused for later queries. Pending results show loading and cannot activate or create a value; the query remains editable. Empty queries and ExternalFilter/IgnoreFilter bypass local work. Query/data/configuration changes, close, unmount and window shutdown cancel obsolete work. Keep state per instance/window and call Close() when disposing the owner; Searching() reports local pending work. Each mounted search surface retains one active worker and one latest pending request. Submission and full matching still cost O(N), while steady rendering builds visible rows. App callbacks and UI builders run on the UI thread. In browser previews, background goroutines cooperatively yield between batches on the shared JavaScript event loop; they are not dedicated Web Workers. The copied program and preview dispose their search state.

note.zh:
- 内置筛选默认仅匹配 `Label`，忽略大小写和音标符号，按「完全匹配 → 前缀 → 包含」排序。
- 单项 `OnSelect` 中可调用 `PreventDefault` 取消本次选择。
- 隐藏筛选框时已有查询词仍生效；如需完全由应用过滤，请设置 `IgnoreFilter: true`。
note.en:
- Built-in filtering matches `Label` by default (ignoring case and accents) and ranks exact, prefix, then substring matches.
- Call `PreventDefault` inside an item's `OnSelect` to cancel selection.
- Hiding the filter keeps an existing query active; set `IgnoreFilter: true` to bypass local filtering.

name: SelectMenu

description.zh: 在弹出下拉列表中搜索并选择一个或多个选项。
description.en: Search and select one or more options inside a popup list.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

`SelectMenu` 将触发按钮、搜索框与 `Listbox` 组合在一起，选中值用 ID 切片保存，`SelectMenuState` 负责管理打开状态、查询词和持久焦点。可通过 `FilterInput` 自定义搜索框，`FocusSearch` 决定打开后聚焦搜索框还是列表。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 打开下拉菜单搜索 `cafe` 并回车，对比开启和关闭「阻止选择 Café」的行为。
2. 选中后点击尾部清空按钮，切换「清空时重置选中值」查看仅清空搜索词还是同时清空选中项。
3. 开启「展示模拟远程搜索」，依次输入不同关键词后点击 `Complete stale request`，体验旧请求自动被拒绝。

### 显式提交数据

每个实例保留独立状态，在初始化、数据替换或异步结果被接受后调用 SetItems。提交后由状态持有描述符快照；修改原数据后需重新提交，nil 释放数据而保留选择与查询。渲染时传入选择状态和组件状态，不再传入数据切片。OnChange 无参数，每次已接受的用户选择变化通知一次；外部选择修改保持静默。Values() 显式复制有序选择。不变的视图构建不扫描全部候选项或选中值。

### 本地搜索执行

将“本地搜索执行”切换为 background 后在筛选框输入。默认 SearchAuto 对不超过 2,048 个候选项同步搜索，超过后使用后台工作线程；SearchImmediate 始终同步，SearchBackground 对非空本地查询始终在后台执行。首次归一化和匹配都在后台，后续查询复用未变的字段缓存。等待时显示加载状态，不能激活旧结果或创建值，查询仍可编辑。空查询和 ExternalFilter/IgnoreFilter 绕过本地匹配。查询、数据、配置变化以及关闭、卸载或窗口关闭会取消过期工作。每个实例和窗口保留独立状态，所有者销毁时调用 Close()，Searching() 表示本地等待状态。每个挂载搜索区域只保留一个活动工作线程及一个最新待执行请求。数据提交和完整匹配仍为 O(N)，不变的渲染仅构建可见行；应用回调和 UI 构建器仍在 UI 线程执行。浏览器预览的后台 goroutine 与 JavaScript 共享事件循环，按批次让出执行权，并非独立 Web Worker。复制的程序和预览都会清理搜索状态。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

`SelectMenu` combines a trigger, search field, and `Listbox`. Store selected IDs in a slice and keep open state, query, and focus handles in `SelectMenuState`. Customize the search input via `FilterInput` and initial focus via `FocusSearch`.

### Try the preview

1. Open the menu, search `cafe`, and press `Enter` with and without `Prevent Café selection`.
2. Select an item and click the clear button, comparing `Reset selection on clear` on vs off.
3. Enable `Show simulated remote search`, type two queries, and click `Complete stale request` to see stale results rejected.

### Submitted data

Keep one state per instance and call SetItems during setup, data replacement, or accepted async completion. The setter owns its descriptors; resubmit after edits, and use nil to release the data without clearing selection or query. Render with the selection state and component state, without a slice argument. OnChange is parameterless and fires once per accepted user change. External selection mutations are silent; Values() explicitly copies the ordered selection. Unchanged builds do not scan all candidates or selected values.

### Local search execution

Try Local search execution = background and type into the filter. SearchAuto (default) searches at most 2,048 candidates immediately and uses a worker above that count; SearchImmediate always runs synchronously and SearchBackground always runs nonempty local queries in the background. Both first normalization and matching run there, with cached fields reused for later queries. Pending results show loading and cannot activate or create a value; the query remains editable. Empty queries and ExternalFilter/IgnoreFilter bypass local work. Query/data/configuration changes, close, unmount and window shutdown cancel obsolete work. Keep state per instance/window and call Close() when disposing the owner; Searching() reports local pending work. Each mounted search surface retains one active worker and one latest pending request. Submission and full matching still cost O(N), while steady rendering builds visible rows. App callbacks and UI builders run on the UI thread. In browser previews, background goroutines cooperatively yield between batches on the shared JavaScript event loop; they are not dedicated Web Workers. The copied program and preview dispose their search state.

note.zh:
- 默认在选择或关闭弹层后清空搜索词；清空按钮始终清除搜索词，`ResetModelValueOnClear` 仅控制是否同时清空选中值。
- `Loading` 会在触发器和列表顶部显示加载状态，已有候选项仍允许选择。
- 远程搜索请配合 `ExternalFilter` / `IgnoreFilter` 和 `QueryState` 丢弃过期结果，并通过 `Window.Update` 回到 UI 线程更新。
note.en:
- Selection and closing clear the search query by default. The clear button always clears the query; `ResetModelValueOnClear` controls whether selections clear too.
- `Loading` shows a trigger spinner and status row while existing items stay selectable.
- For remote search, use `ExternalFilter`/`IgnoreFilter` with `QueryState` to drop stale responses, and publish results on the UI thread via `Window.Update`.

name: Calendar

description.zh: 在月历视图中选择单个日期或起止日期范围。
description.en: Pick a single date or a date range from a calendar grid.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

`Calendar` 绑定 `DateSelection`，`CalendarState` 保存当前展示月份、活动日期、年月导航视图和键盘焦点。默认再次点击已选日期可取消选择（可通过 `PreventDeselect` 关闭）；`ReadOnly` 允许翻月和聚焦但不改值。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 点击日期选择或取消，点击顶部标题切换月视图和年视图快速跳转。
2. 开启「区间选择」选取起止日期，测试「标记每月 20 日不可用」「范围可跨不可用日期」和「范围最多天数」。
3. 将「显示月数」设为 `2`，再尝试「固定六周」「周序号」和「按显示月数翻页」。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

`Calendar` binds `DateSelection`, while `CalendarState` tracks the visible month, active date, navigation view, and focus. Clicking the selected date again clears it by default (disable via `PreventDeselect`); `ReadOnly` allows browsing without editing.

### Try the preview

1. Select or deselect dates, and click the heading to jump through month and year views.
2. Enable `Range` and test unavailable dates, `Allow unavailable dates in range`, and `Max range days`.
3. Set `Displayed months` to `2` and toggle `Fixed weeks`, `Week numbers`, and `Page by displayed months`.

note.zh:
- 本示例固定今天和初始值为 2024-02-15 且周一为每周起点；组件默认以周日为一周起点（`WeekStart`），周序号按所设起点计算。
- 不可用日期可浏览但不能作为端点；`AllowNonContiguousRanges` 仅允许范围跨越不可用日期，仍不能跨越禁用日期。
- 月/年视图仅用于快速导航，最终绑定值始终为公历日期或日期范围；外部直接修改模型不触发 `OnChange`。
note.en:
- This demo pins today and the initial date to Feb 15, 2024 with Monday as week start; the component defaults to Sunday (`WeekStart`), and week numbers follow it.
- Unavailable dates can be focused but not chosen as endpoints; `AllowNonContiguousRanges` allows crossing unavailable dates, not disabled ones.
- Month/year views are for navigation only—values are always Gregorian dates or ranges, and external updates do not fire `OnChange`.

name: InputDate

description.zh: 按年、月、日分段编辑日期，也支持弹出日历选择。
description.en: Edit year, month, and day segments directly or pick from a popup calendar.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

单日绑定 `Optional[Date]` 和 `DateInputState`，范围绑定 `DateSelection` 和 `DateRangeInputState`。输入未完成或超出规则限制时会保留最后一次有效值；单日回调使用 `OnValueChange`，范围回调使用 `OnRangeChange`。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 点击年/月/日分段输入数字或用上下键增减，调整「日期步长」观察变化幅度。
2. 开启「显示日历按钮」，通过弹出日历选择单日或起止范围。
3. 开启「限制有效范围」（2024 年 2–3 月）和「20 日不可用」，体验输入校验与自定义范围分隔符。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Bind `Optional[Date]` + `DateInputState` for a single date, or `DateSelection` + `DateRangeInputState` for a range. Incomplete or rejected drafts keep the last valid value. Use `OnValueChange` for single dates and `OnRangeChange` for ranges.

### Try the preview

1. Focus a date segment to type or step with Up/Down, and adjust `Day step`.
2. Enable `Show calendar` to pick a date or range from the popup.
3. Turn on `Restrict valid range` (Feb–Mar 2024) and `20th unavailable`, or try `Custom range separator`.

note.zh:
- `ShowCalendar` 默认 `false`，且 `HideCalendar` 优先级更高；`Calendar` 中的边界与禁用规则同样约束分段输入。
- 空分段首次用上下键调整时以 `PlaceholderValue` 为基准；字符串 `Placeholder`、`Password`、`MaxLength` 对分段输入不生效。
- 仅表示公历日期，不包含时间或时区。
note.en:
- `ShowCalendar` defaults to `false` and `HideCalendar` takes precedence; `Calendar` bounds and predicates also govern segment edits.
- `PlaceholderValue` seeds empty segments when stepping; string `Placeholder`, `Password`, and `MaxLength` do not apply.
- Represents Gregorian calendar dates only, without time of day or time zone.

name: InputTime

description.zh: 分段编辑时、分、秒，支持 12 小时制和 24 小时制。
description.en: Edit hours, minutes, and seconds by segment in 12- or 24-hour format.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

绑定 `Optional[ClockTime]` 与 `TimeInputState`。`TwelveHour` 未设置时自动跟随系统/语言习惯，设为 `false` 强制使用 24 小时制；`Granularity` 控制显示精度（时 / 分 / 秒），未设置时由 `Seconds` 决定。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 聚焦时、分或秒分段，键入数字或按上下键按步长调整。
2. 切换「12 小时制」「显示精度」和「失焦时对齐步长」，观察隐藏单位如何保留。
3. 开启「限制有效范围」（09:00–17:30），尝试输入范围外时间查看校验效果。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Bind `Optional[ClockTime]` and `TimeInputState`. Unset `TwelveHour` follows the locale hour cycle (`false` forces 24-hour). `Granularity` picks hour, minute, or second precision (otherwise follows `Seconds`).

### Try the preview

1. Focus a segment to type digits or step with Up/Down.
2. Toggle `12-hour format`, `Granularity`, and `Snap on blur`—changing precision preserves hidden units without firing a change event.
3. Enable `Restrict valid range` (09:00–17:30) and test out-of-range edits.

note.zh:
- 超出 `Min`/`Max`（含边界）或不可用的编辑会保留为草稿，不覆盖原有效值；范围比较包含隐藏的秒等单位。
- 组件表示单个时刻（不含日期、毫秒或时区）；如需时间区间，可组合两个 `InputTime` 并自行校验。
note.en:
- Out-of-range (`Min`/`Max` are inclusive) or unavailable edits stay as drafts without replacing the valid value; bounds compare the full time including hidden units.
- Represents a single time of day without date, milliseconds, or time zone; combine two `InputTime` controls for a range.

name: ColorPicker

description.zh: 通过色域面板、滑条、预设色板或 RGBA 数值选择颜色。
description.en: Pick a color using a spectrum panel, sliders, swatches, or RGBA inputs.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

绑定 `*ui.Color` 与持久保存的 `ColorPickerState`。色域平面、色相与透明度滑条、HEX/HEXA、预设色板及 RGBA 数值框实时联动同一颜色；五档 `Size` 会同步调整面板和输入框大小（`MD` 默认 168 DIP）。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 在色域面板拖动选色，或直接编辑 HEX 与 RGBA 通道数值，对比当前值与最近一次回调值。
2. 调整「通知间隔」（`Throttle` 默认 50ms，设为 `0` 每次变化立即回调），观察 `OnChange` 触发频率。
3. 切换尺寸、「部件样式」和「从右向左的表单」查看布局适配。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Bind `*ui.Color` and a persistent `ColorPickerState`. The spectrum area, hue/opacity sliders, HEX/HEXA input, swatches, and RGBA fields stay in sync. All five `Size` options scale the picker and inputs (`MD` defaults to 168 DIP).

### Try the preview

1. Drag in the color area or edit HEX/RGBA values and compare the current color against the latest callback.
2. Adjust `Notification interval` (`Throttle` defaults to 50ms; `0` emits every change) to see callback throttling.
3. Switch `Size`, `Part styles`, and `RTL form`.

note.zh:
- `Throttle` 仅合并 `OnChange` 回调，绑定的 `ui.Color` 始终实时更新；外部赋值不触发 `OnChange`。
- `UI` 支持 `Root`、`Panel`、`Body`、`Item`、`Label`，原生内部色域、滑条和 HEX 框不单独暴露样式部件。
- 基于 sRGB `ui.Color` 模型，不支持广色域、HSL/CMYK/Lab 文本输入或屏幕取色器；RTL 下色域面板保持从左到右以确保操作直觉。
note.en:
- `Throttle` coalesces `OnChange` callbacks only—the bound `ui.Color` updates immediately, and external assignments are silent.
- `UI` exposes `Root`, `Panel`, `Body`, `Item`, and `Label`; internal spectrum, slider, and HEX parts are not individually styled.
- Uses sRGB `ui.Color` without wide-gamut, HSL/CMYK/Lab text input, or eyedropper. In RTL, the color panel stays LTR so pointer positions match gradients.

name: Table

description.zh: 按行列展示结构化数据，支持虚拟滚动、单/多列排序和行选择。
description.en: Display tabular data with virtual scrolling, single/multi-column sorting, and row selection.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

通过 `TableState.SetRows` 传入数据，每行必须有唯一且稳定的 `ID`。列定义中 `Value` 提供纯文本、`Compare` 提供本地排序规则、`Cell` 可自定义单元格内容；将 `List.SortBy` 指向持久切片即可启用多列排序，`ManualSorting: true` 则保留输入顺序交由外部服务端排序。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 点击表头 `Project` 切换排序，选中行后按 `Enter` 查看激活 ID；开启「多列排序」后按住 `Shift` 点击 `Length`。
2. 开启「加载中」或「空数据」，观察加载条、已有数据保留和空状态提示。
3. 调整表格高度、列宽、RTL 和可见标题，确认选择状态得以保留。

### 借用行数据与数值 ID

开启「借用行数据」可使用同一个表格渲染器而不复制行值，排序也不会修改应用持有的数组。借用模式要求调用方保证 ID 唯一、稳定，在主线程修改数据后重新绑定；清空数据会释放借用视图。数值 ID 使用 `KeyedTableState[Request, uint64]`、`SetBorrowedRows(requests, func(row Request) uint64 { return row.ID })` 和 `KeyedTableOptions[uint64]`，回调保留数值类型，支持零和大于 2^63 的 ID。`TableState[T]` 与 `TableOptions` 保持原有字符串接口。自定义单元格装饰可使用 `BuildCell`，通过 `TableCell[T]` 获取行索引、行值、选择状态，另一个参数 `Element` 是仅当前构建有效的容器。

### 原生 Table 迁移

已移除 OnSelectionChange。OnChange 是统一用户通知：Ctrl+Down 可能仅移动游标，列手势可能仅改变布局。重建与外部赋值保持静默。简单判断使用 Selection.Len/Has；显式遍历或排序快照分别需要 O(S) 或 O(S log S)。严格的选择变化监听由应用承担比较成本。

启用「单元格选择」和「首列作为行头」可测试整行/整表选择。RowHeader 永不排序；RowHeight 仍设置在 ListState，0 保留原生自动高度。HeaderCell、表头/单元格菜单、FollowEnd 和触底加载保持可用，同时遵守原生拖拽互斥及动效限制。

仅无 Item/Label 装饰和自定义回调的 Value 单元格使用简化路径，其他装饰路径及表头分隔线保留。表格虚拟化行而不虚拟化列：固定测试视口中 5/50/200 列会构建 55/550/2200 个单元格。手动排序按应用发布的顺序显示；仓库 examples/table-manual-sorting 展示可取消工作线程、最新请求校验、不可变结果及 Window.Update 发布。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Load data with `TableState.SetRows`, giving each row a stable, unique `ID`. Columns define text via `Value`, local sorting via `Compare`, and custom rendering via `Cell`. Point `List.SortBy` at a persistent slice for multi-column sorting, or enable `ManualSorting` for server-side sorting.

### Try the preview

1. Click the `Project` header to sort, select a row and press `Enter` to activate it; enable `Multi-column sorting` and Shift-click `Length`.
2. Toggle `Loading` and `Empty data` to see the loading indicator and empty state.
3. Adjust height, column widths, RTL, and visible caption.

### Borrowing and typed IDs

Toggle `Borrowed rows` to use the same table renderer without copying row values. Sorting still leaves the application array unchanged. Borrowed rows require caller-validated unique stable IDs and main-thread rebinding after changes; clearing data releases the borrowed view. For numeric IDs, use `KeyedTableState[Request, uint64]`, `SetBorrowedRows(requests, func(row Request) uint64 { return row.ID })`, and `KeyedTableOptions[uint64]`; callbacks keep numeric IDs, including zero and values above 2^63. `TableState[T]` and `TableOptions` retain the existing string API. Use `BuildCell` with `TableCell[T].Index`, `.Value`, `.Selected`, and the separate current-build Element parameter when custom cell decoration needs row context.

### Native Table migration

OnSelectionChange is removed. OnChange is a combined user notification: Ctrl+Down can move only the cursor, and column gestures can change only layout. Rebuilds and external updates stay silent. Read Selection.Len/Has for simple questions; requesting All or a sorted snapshot explicitly costs O(S) or O(S log S). Strict selection-only observers must own that comparison cost.

Enable Cell selection and First column as row header to try whole-row/table selection. RowHeader never sorts; RowHeight remains a ListState setting with zero keeping native automatic height. Native HeaderCell, HeaderMenu, CellMenu, FollowEnd and paging settings remain available, with their native drag/motion restrictions.

The plain Value cell path is used only without relevant Item/Label styles or custom callbacks. All decorated cells and the header divider are preserved. Rows are virtual; columns are not: 5/50/200 columns build 55/550/2200 cells in the fixed test viewport. Manual sorting keeps application order; the repository examples/table-manual-sorting program demonstrates a cancellable worker, latest-request generation checks, immutable results and Window.Update publication.

note.zh:
- 表头固定在滚动区上方，始终启用原生虚拟列表；`Fixed` 仅禁止拖拽换列和调宽，不是「冻结列」。
- `OnChange` 报告游标、选择、排序和已完成的列布局变更，需要时显式读取选中键；`OnActivate` 在 `Enter` 或双击时触发（不同于 Nuxt UI 的单击行 `select`）。
- 筛选、分页、数据请求需由应用自行实现（可用 `List.EndReached` 配合 `NearEnd` 实现触底加载）；暂不支持冻结列、多级表头、行展开和分组聚合。
- `SetRows` 复制并校验数据；`SetBorrowedRows` 信任调用方的数据和唯一键，不保留完整成员表。不要持有 `BuildCell` 提供的 Element。
note.en:
- Headers stay pinned above the virtualized body. `Fixed` locks column reordering and resizing—it does not freeze columns while horizontally scrolling.
- `OnChange` reports cursor, selection, sort and completed column layout; read selected keys explicitly when needed. `OnActivate` fires on `Enter` or double-click (unlike Nuxt UI's single-click `select`).
- Filtering, pagination, and fetching belong to your app (use `List.EndReached` + `NearEnd` for load-more). Frozen columns, grouped headers, row expansion, and aggregation are not supported.
- `SetRows` copies and validates. `SetBorrowedRows` trusts caller-owned data and unique keys; it does not retain a membership map. Never retain the Element supplied to BuildCell.

name: Tree

description.zh: 以层级树形结构展示数据，支持展开折叠、懒加载和多选联动。
description.en: Display hierarchical tree data with expansion, lazy loading, and linked selection.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

仅在数据变化时调用 `SetNodes`，为每个节点提供唯一且稳定的 `ID`。`Selection` 保存选中项，`Outline.Open` 保存展开节点，`Active` 保存键盘高亮。默认点击行会同时选择并切换展开，键盘 `Enter`/`Space` 只选择、左右键展开折叠；`OnSelect`/`OnToggle` 可调用 `PreventDefault` 拦截。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 点击 `src` 或用左右方向键展开折叠，开启「保护 src」测试事件拦截。
2. 开启「多选」「同时选择子节点」和「根据子项更新父节点」，观察部分选中时的 `Mixed` 状态。
3. 展开 `Remote files` 后点击 `Complete empty load` 或先折叠再完成，体验懒加载与过期结果拒绝。
4. 开启自定义内容和多选联动，选择一个子项以显示 `Mixed`。关闭两种联动选项或关闭多选，`Mixed` 会消失且不触发选择回调；重新开启联动后按当前选择重新计算。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Call `SetNodes` only when data changes, assigning each node a stable, unique `ID`. `Selection` holds selected IDs, `Outline.Open` holds expanded IDs, and `Active` tracks keyboard highlight. By default, clicking selects and toggles expansion, while `Enter`/`Space` selects and Left/Right expand/collapse; `OnSelect`/`OnToggle` can cancel via `PreventDefault`.

### Try the preview

1. Expand/collapse `src` by clicking or pressing Left/Right, and test `Protect src`.
2. Enable `Multiple`, `Select descendants`, and `Update parents from children` to see mixed parent states.
3. Expand `Remote files` and try `Complete empty load` or collapse before completing to see stale-result rejection.
4. Enable custom content and linked multiple selection, then select one child to show `Mixed`. Disable both linking options or Multiple: `Mixed` disappears without a selection callback. Re-enable linking to recompute from the current selection.

note.zh:
- 父子联动仅作用于已加载的可用节点，遇到禁用节点会停止，后续懒加载的子项不会自动继承父节点选中态。
- 嵌套模式（`Nested`）和普通模式均使用原生虚拟列表；自定义首尾构建器中请只放展示元素，交互由整行和键盘统一处理。
- 空分支会保留展开状态但不再补默认文件夹和展开箭头。
- 单独使用自定义部件不会为计算混合状态遍历折叠后代。未联动时 Indeterminate 始终为 false，并在构建前清除旧的联动汇总。展开 ID 检查和联动选择协调的成本仍随数据量变化。
note.en:
- Parent-child selection applies to loaded, enabled nodes, stops at disabled nodes, and does not auto-select children loaded later.
- Both `Nested` and flat layouts are natively virtualized. Keep custom leading/trailing builders display-only; rows and keyboard handle interaction.
- Loaded empty branches keep expanded state without fallback folder or chevron icons.
- Custom parts alone do not traverse folded descendants for mixed state. Unlinked modes always report Indeterminate=false and clear old linked summaries before building. Expanded-ID checks and linked-selection reconciliation still have data-dependent costs.

name: CommandPalette

description.zh: 全局命令搜索面板，支持分组、多级子命令和异步搜索。
description.en: Searchable command launcher with groups, nested sub-commands, and async search.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

用 `NewCommandIndex` 创建不可变索引并交给持久的 `CommandPaletteState`（数据变化时再调用 `SetIndex`）。即使面板处于关闭状态也要继续调用 `CommandPalette`，以维持快捷键监听和关闭后焦点恢复。`OnSelect` 接收最终执行的命令 ID，`OnSelectEvent` 可提前取消执行。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 点击 `Open commands`，搜索 `invoice` 或 `Local` 查看高亮，进入 `Appearance options` 后按 `Backspace` 返回上级。
2. 关闭「保护指定命令」并开启「执行后保持打开」，重复执行命令查看计数。
3. 开启「手动返回搜索结果」，连续输入两个关键词并用 `Try stale result` / `Complete search` 体验异步票据校验。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Build an immutable index with `NewCommandIndex` and store it in a persistent `CommandPaletteState` (call `SetIndex` only when data changes). Keep rendering `CommandPalette` while closed so shortcuts and focus restoration work. `OnSelect` receives executed IDs; `OnSelectEvent` can cancel beforehand.

### Try the preview

1. Click `Open commands`, search `invoice` or `Local`, enter `Appearance options`, and press `Backspace` on an empty search to go back.
2. Turn off `Protect command` and enable `Keep open` to run commands repeatedly.
3. Enable `Manual results`, type two queries, and test `Try stale result` vs `Complete search`.

note.zh:
- 内置搜索默认匹配 `label`、`description`、`suffix`、`keywords`，最多显示 200 条且始终启用虚拟列表；自定义 `Search` 回调负责全部筛选。
- 更换自定义 `Search` 回调后请调用 `Refresh`，卸载页面或关闭窗口时调用 `Close`。
- 作为原生命令启动器，执行后默认自动关闭，不提供嵌入式多选或网页路由属性（本预览已禁用默认快捷键）。
note.en:
- Built-in search matches `label`, `description`, `suffix`, and `keywords` (up to 200 virtualized results); custom `Search` callbacks own filtering.
- Call `Refresh` after replacing a custom `Search` callback, and `Close` on unmount or window close.
- Closes after running a command by default and does not expose embedded multi-select or web router props (default shortcut is disabled in this preview).

name: NavigationMenu

description.zh: 展示应用的主导航栏与多级子菜单，支持横向、纵向和紧凑模式。
description.en: Render primary app navigation and submenus in horizontal, vertical, or compact layouts.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

用字符串 ID 保存当前选中页面，`NavigationState.Expanded` 保存纵向分支的展开状态。`OnNavigate` 处理页面切换，叶项 `OnSelect` 可调用 `PreventDefault` 取消导航；组件不解析 URL，父级条目只用于展开子菜单。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 点击 `Projects` 查看激活状态；打开 `Settings` 点击 `Protected destination` 体验取消导航。
2. 开启「纵向」，对比「同级只展开一项」「允许收起」和「紧凑布局」（支持悬停提示和侧边弹层）。
3. 切换颜色、样式（`pill`/`link`）、活动指示线和 RTL。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Track the active destination by ID and vertical expansion in `NavigationState.Expanded`. Handle page changes in `OnNavigate` (leaf `OnSelect` can call `PreventDefault` to cancel). Parent items expand children; URLs are not resolved automatically.

### Try the preview

1. Click `Projects` to switch pages, or open `Settings` → `Protected destination` to see navigation canceled.
2. Enable `Vertical` to test `Single branch`, `Collapsible`, and `Compact` (with tooltips and side popovers).
3. Switch colors, variants (`pill`/`link`), `Highlight`, and RTL.

note.zh:
- 默认横向、`Primary` 颜色、`Soft`（药丸）样式；`Compact` 仅对纵向导航生效，紧凑模式的 `Tooltip` 和 `Popover` 默认开启。
- `Single` 限制同级仅展开一项，`Collapsible` 仅在 `Single` 下限制是否允许全部收起；外部直接修改 `Expanded` 不触发通知。
- 横向子菜单基于原生 `DropdownMenu`，不提供网页版共享巨型菜单（mega menu）视口或自动路由匹配。
note.en:
- Defaults to horizontal, `Primary`, and `Soft` (pill). `Compact` applies to vertical navigation only, with `Tooltip` and `Popover` enabled by default.
- `Single` limits sibling expansion and `Collapsible` applies only in `Single` mode; external `Expanded` edits are silent.
- Horizontal submenus use native `DropdownMenu` rather than a shared mega-menu viewport or automatic route matching.

description.zh: 从窗口底部弹出的抽屉面板，支持拖动手柄在多个高度间切换。
description.en: Bottom sheet drawer with a drag handle and customizable snap heights.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

持久保存 `DrawerState`，用 `Open` 控制开关、`Snap` 选择当前停靠高度。`SnapPoints` 按窗口可用高度比例递增填写（如 `0.5`、`0.85`）；即使关闭期间也要继续调用 `Drawer`，以完成退出动画和焦点恢复。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 点击 `Open drawer` 打开抽屉，拖动手柄（或聚焦手柄后用上下键、`Home`/`End`）切换不同停靠高度。
2. 关闭「拖动或 Esc 关闭」，尝试 `Escape`、点遮罩或向下拖动，观察拦截计数（`Done` 按钮仍可直接关闭）。
3. 切换手柄、关闭按钮、「保留边缘间距」和自定义指示条，重新打开确认草稿与停靠位置保持不变。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Keep `DrawerState` persistent, controlling visibility with `Open` and height stop with `Snap`. `SnapPoints` are ascending fractions of available height (e.g. `0.5`, `0.85`). Keep calling `Drawer` while closed for exit animation and focus return.

### Try the preview

1. Click `Open drawer`, then drag the handle (or focus it and press Up/Down, `Home`/`End`) to switch snap heights.
2. Disable `Allow dismissal` and try `Escape`, outside clicks, or dragging down while watching `Prevented`.
3. Toggle the handle, close button, `Inset`, and custom indicator; reopen to verify draft and snap position persist.

note.zh:
- 仅支持从底部展开且通过手柄拖动；`SnapPoints` 仅接受 `(0, 1]` 比例（默认 `0.5`、`0.85`），不支持像素字符串。
- `DismissDistance` 与 `DismissVelocity` 为原生关闭阈值（`0` 使用默认值）；`Overlay: false` 仅隐藏遮罩背景，仍保持模态焦点限制。
- 继承自 `ModalOptions` 的 `Width`、`MaxHeight` 和 `Fullscreen` 对 `Drawer` 不生效。
note.en:
- Opens from the bottom only and drags via its handle. `SnapPoints` accepts fractions in `(0, 1]` (default `0.5`, `0.85`), not pixel strings.
- `DismissDistance` and `DismissVelocity` are native dismissal thresholds (`0` uses defaults). `Overlay: false` hides the backdrop while keeping modal focus trapping.
- Inherited `Width`, `MaxHeight`, and `Fullscreen` from `ModalOptions` do not apply.

name: FileUpload

description.zh: 选择或拖放文件，校验规则并展示上传状态与进度。
description.en: Pick or drop files, validate them, and display upload status and progress.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

用 `FileUploadState` 保存文件队列，应用通过 `Begin` 和 `Report` 更新真实上传进度。`Rules` 负责校验文件类型、大小和数量，被拒绝的文件会保留并显示原因；`OnChange` 在队列变化时通知，`OnReject` 报告新增的拒绝项。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 点击 `Project files` 添加示例文件，观察队列、校验拒绝和计数变化。
2. 将「模拟选择结果」改为 `cancel` 或 `error` 再次点击，确认取消和出错不会破坏现有队列。
3. 切换选择入口样式、列表/网格布局、列表位置以及文件头像显示。

### 有界文件预览

PreviewHeight 默认 320 DIP；0 不构建预览视口，负数及非有限数触发 panic。Preview=false 同样只隐藏预览，不改变文件或任务。点击 Load 10,000 previews 体验滚动、列表/网格切换和高度调整。Add 根据当前 Files 一次建立临时集合，以 O(已有文件 + 新增文件) 的批量处理保留路径去重、拒绝原因及顺序；直接外部修改 Files 后也不会使用过期缓存。Report 和当前任务查询仍遍历文件。

列表测量可见行高度；网格使用按主题和文字缩放计算的固定卡片，名称与状态一行，错误最多两行。无障碍文本保留完整名称和错误；错误文字可通过键盘聚焦，提示展示完整消息。点击 Show long error 可检查长错误。原生网格在布局后更新列数，切换布局时恢复文件操作焦点，移除或取消后焦点回到选择入口。自定义 FileDeleteOptions、组件 Style 回调或行字体/间距覆盖使用测量型 List 回退。网格中的 Avatar 装饰必须符合所声明的头像尺寸；任意头像尺寸请使用 UploadList。仅构建可见预览及原生有限预读。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Store queued files in `FileUploadState` and drive real transfers via `Begin` and `Report`. `Rules` validates file type, size, and count, keeping rejected entries with reasons. `OnChange` reports queue updates; `OnReject` reports newly rejected files.

### Try the preview

1. Click `Project files` to add sample files and inspect queue updates and rejections.
2. Switch `Simulated result` to `cancel` or `error` to confirm neither alters the existing queue.
3. Compare picker variants, list vs grid layout, list position, and file avatars.

### Bounded file previews

PreviewHeight defaults to 320 DIP; zero builds no preview viewport, and negative/nonfinite values panic. Preview=false also hides previews without changing files or jobs. Load 10,000 previews to try scrolling, switch list/grid, and resize the viewport. Add uses temporary sets from the current Files collection, preserving duplicate-path suppression and rejected-file order in O(existing + incoming) admission work; direct external Files edits are respected. Report and current-job lookup still scan files.

List mode measures visible rows. Grid mode uses fixed cards sized from the theme/text scale, single-line names/status and at most two error lines. Complete names/errors remain in accessibility text; the error can receive keyboard focus and its tooltip contains the full message. Try Show long error. The native grid updates its columns after layout; file action focus is restored across layout changes and removal/cancel returns focus to the picker. Custom FileDeleteOptions, component Style callbacks or row typography/spacing overrides use the measured List fallback. Grid Avatar decorations must fit the declared avatar size; use UploadList for arbitrary avatar sizing. Builders only create visible previews and native overscan.

note.zh:
- `Dialog.Multiple` 仅决定系统对话框单次能否多选，队列总文件数上限请通过 `Rules.MaxFiles` 控制。
- 列表位置（`Position`）仅在 `UploadArea` / `UploadList` 下生效；组件不读取文件内容也不负责网络上传，页面卸载时请调用 `Dispose`。
- 预览通过 `Choose` 返回模拟文件，不会打开本机对话框或上传数据。
note.en:
- `Dialog.Multiple` only enables multi-select inside one OS dialog; use `Rules.MaxFiles` to cap total queued files.
- `Position` applies only to `UploadArea` / `UploadList`. The component does not read file bytes or perform network uploads; call `Dispose` on unmount.
- This preview uses a mock `Choose` callback and never opens an OS dialog or uploads files.

name: Chart

description.zh: 用折线图、柱状图、面积图或圆环图可视化数据。
description.en: Visualize data as line, bar, area, or donut charts.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

持久保存 `ChartState`，按图表类型调用 `SetCategories`、`SetData`、`SetTimeData` 或 `SetSlices` 更新数据。多于一个系列或扇区时默认自动显示可点击图例；`Height` 默认 300 DIP，未设置高度时可用 `AspectRatio` 按比例决定高度。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 切换折线、柱状、面积、圆环等图表类型，圆环图可调节厚度并展示中心内容。
2. 点击图例中的 `Views` 或 `Visits` 隐藏/显示系列，或聚焦图表后用左右键和 `Enter`/`Space` 浏览与激活数据点。
3. 切换坐标轴、网格、数据点、提示框和自定义配色。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Keep `ChartState` persistent and populate it with `SetCategories`, `SetData`, `SetTimeData`, or `SetSlices`. Interactive legends appear automatically when there are multiple series or slices. `Height` defaults to 300 DIP (or use `AspectRatio` when height is unset).

### Try the preview

1. Switch between line, bar, area, and donut charts—donuts also support `Donut thickness` and `Center content`.
2. Click legend items (`Views`/`Visits`) to toggle series, or focus the chart and navigate with arrows and `Enter`/`Space`.
3. Toggle axes, grid, data points, tooltips, and custom palettes.

note.zh:
- 图表由 MyGo 原生绘制，除常用类型外还支持散点图、饼图以及数值/时间轴。
- `Height` 仅涵盖绘图与坐标区，图例、轴标题和底部说明行另占空间；圆环图显式设置的 `DonutInnerRadius` 优先于 `Thickness`。
- `ChartSelection` 标识整列 X 数据或单个扇区，`YLabel` 水平显示在图表上方。
note.en:
- Drawn natively with MyGo; also supports scatter, pie, and numeric/time axes.
- `Height` covers the plot and axes only, with legends, titles, and the summary line taking extra space. Explicit `DonutInnerRadius` overrides `Thickness`.
- `ChartSelection` identifies an X column or slice; `YLabel` renders horizontally above the plot.

name: Carousel

description.zh: 在一组卡片间通过拖动、按钮或自动轮播逐页切换。
description.en: Page through cards by dragging, buttons, keyboard, or autoplay.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

持久保存 `CarouselState`，通过 `Index` 读取或切换当前页；每页需提供唯一 `ID` 和同步 `Build` 回调。`Arrows` 与 `Dots` 默认关闭（本例开启了圆点）；`Wrap` 让按钮、键盘和自动播放首尾循环，拖拽仍保留首末边界。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 拖动卡片，或使用圆点、前后箭头和方向键翻页；在页内输入草稿并切换方向确认数据不丢失。
2. 开启「自动播放」观察定时翻页：悬停或聚焦时会临时暂停，操作箭头/拖拽后按「交互后暂停」决定是否停止。
3. 开启「循环翻页」并在首末页切换，或尝试自定义按钮图标、头像与圆点样式。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Keep `CarouselState` persistent and track the active page via `Index`; each item needs a stable `ID` and synchronous `Build` callback. `Arrows` and `Dots` default to `false` (this demo enables dots). `Wrap` loops buttons, keys, and autoplay while drags remain bounded.

### Try the preview

1. Drag slides or navigate with dots, arrows, and arrow keys while editing a slide draft.
2. Enable `Autoplay`: hovering or focusing pauses temporarily, while `Stop on interaction` pauses after manual navigation until resumed.
3. Test `Wrap` at the first/last page, plus custom arrows, avatars, and dot styles.

note.zh:
- 为单页原生轮播，不提供自由拖拽、多页分组或 Embla 插件 API；切换动画在减少动态效果时立即到位。
- `Active` 仅控制自动播放开关，不会禁用手动翻页；不可见、减少动态效果或关闭动画时自动播放会自动暂停。
- 当前页及相邻页会执行 `Build`（非当前页禁用交互），业务任务请在按钮等动作回调中启动。
note.en:
- Single-page native carousel without drag-free mode, multi-slide groups, or Embla plugins; transitions snap immediately under reduced motion.
- `Active` gates autoplay only and never disables manual navigation; autoplay pauses automatically when offscreen, under reduced motion, or with animations off.
- `Build` runs for the current slide and its neighbors (non-current slides are inert); trigger side effects from actions only.

name: Marquee

description.zh: 以跑马灯效果连续滚动展示文字或徽标等纯展示内容。
description.en: Continuously scroll display-only text, logos, or badges in a marquee.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

`Repeat` 设置内容重复份数（默认 4 份，设为 `0` 不渲染，仅 1 份时滚动可能出现空白），`Speed` 控制速度（默认 32 DIP/秒），`Gap` 控制间距（默认 64 DIP）。内容回调应只放置纯展示元素。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 调整速度和重复份数，切换横向/纵向、反向滚动和「两端渐隐」。
2. 点击 `Pause / resume` 或聚焦后按 `Space` 暂停/继续；开启「悬停暂停」体验鼠标移入即停。
3. 点击 `Replace content` 替换展示内容并重置滚动位置。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

`Repeat` sets how many copies are rendered (default 4; `0` builds nothing, and `1` may leave a gap). `Speed` defaults to 32 DIP/s and `Gap` to 64 DIP. Keep the content callback display-only.

### Try the preview

1. Adjust speed and copies, then toggle orientation, `Reverse`, and `Edge fade`.
2. Click `Pause / resume`, press `Space` while focused, or try `Pause on hover`.
3. Click `Replace content` to update items and reset the scroll offset.

note.zh:
- 内容回调会按 `Repeat` 次数重复构建，切勿在其中放置输入框、按钮或触发业务副作用。
- 聚焦、暂停、`Active: false`、父级禁用、移出可见区、减少动态效果或关闭动画时，滚动均会自动停止。
- 原生速度单位为 `DIP/秒`（不同于 Nuxt UI 的 CSS 周期秒数）；网站预览限制最多 100 份。
note.en:
- The callback runs `Repeat` times per build—do not put interactive controls or side effects inside it.
- Motion pauses automatically on focus, manual pause, `Active: false`, disabled ancestors, offscreen clipping, reduced motion, or animations off.
- Native speed is in DIP/s (unlike Nuxt UI's CSS cycle duration); website previews cap copies at 100.

name: Splitter

description.zh: 通过拖动或键盘调整两个相邻面板的尺寸比例。
description.en: Resize two adjacent panes by dragging their divider or using the keyboard.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

`Splitter` 绑定第一面板的 `*float32` 尺寸：默认单位为 DIP，开启 `Percent: true` 时为 0–100 百分比。`Min`、`Max` 和 `KeyboardResizeBy` 均与绑定值使用相同单位（未设键盘步长时默认每次移动 10 DIP）。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 拖动中间分隔条，或按 `Tab` 聚焦分隔条后用方向键、`Home`/`End` 调整大小。
2. 开启「锁定分隔条」确认面板内输入框仍可编辑，再开启「禁用父容器」对比整组禁用。
3. 开启「嵌套面板」，分别拖动横向和纵向分隔条，体验多级分屏。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

`Splitter` binds the first pane's size as `*float32` in DIP, or as a 0–100 percentage when `Percent: true`. `Min`, `Max`, and `KeyboardResizeBy` share that unit (unset keyboard step defaults to 10 DIP).

### Try the preview

1. Drag the divider, or press `Tab` to focus it and resize with arrow keys, `Home`, and `End`.
2. Compare `Lock divider` (pane input remains editable) with `Disable parent` (everything disables).
3. Enable `Nested panels` to drag both horizontal and vertical dividers.

note.zh:
- `Disabled` 仅锁定分隔条拖动；支持两个面板以及嵌套组合，暂不支持多面板联动、一键折叠停靠或自动记忆尺寸。
- 面板保留 40 DIP 最小尺寸约束；布局仅占 1 DIP 线宽，8 DIP 拖拽热区覆盖两侧边缘不挤占内容空间。
- `UI[SeparatorSlot]` 控制拖拽热区，`UI[Indicator]` 控制可见线条外观。
note.en:
- `Disabled` locks only the divider. Supports two panes and nested splitters, without coordinated multi-pane groups, collapsing/docking, or auto-persistence.
- Panes keep a 40 DIP minimum. Only the 1 DIP line occupies layout space; the 8 DIP drag target overlaps pane edges.
- Style the hit area via `UI[SeparatorSlot]` and the visible line via `UI[Indicator]`.

name: Sidebar

description.zh: 应用侧边栏，支持桌面折叠、拖拽调宽和窄屏弹层切换。
description.en: Application sidebar with desktop collapse, drag resizing, and narrow-window overlays.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

`Sidebar` 包含页头（标题、说明、操作）、可滚动正文和页脚。桌面端折叠状态保存在 `*bool` 中，当前宽度与窄窗口开关保存在 `SidebarState` 中；可用 `HeaderContent` 自定义页头。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 折叠/展开侧边栏并拖动右边缘调整宽度（双击边缘恢复默认宽度），确认侧栏内草稿不丢失。
2. 切换左右位置、区域样式、宽度过渡和 RTL 方向。
3. 将「窄屏切换宽度」设得比预览区域更宽，体验窄窗口下切换为 `Slideover`、`Modal` 或 `Drawer` 弹层。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

`Sidebar` provides a header (title, description, actions), scrollable body, and footer. Keep desktop collapse state in a `*bool` and width/overlay state in `SidebarState`. Use `HeaderContent` to customize the header.

### Try the preview

1. Collapse/expand the sidebar and drag its edge to resize (double-click to reset) while preserving drafts inside.
2. Switch sides, region styles, width transitions, and RTL.
3. Set `Overlay width` wider than the preview to test narrow-window `Slideover`, `Modal`, and `Drawer` overlays.

note.zh:
- 组件默认关闭断点和调宽（本示例手动启用了 160–360 DIP 调宽和 64 DIP 折叠宽度）。
- 桌面端 `collapsed` 与窄屏 `Open` 互相独立；若隐藏所有内置开关按钮，请提供外部按钮并配置 `ReturnFocus`。
- 跨断点切换时会保留应用数据，但控件局部滚动位置不会迁移；暂不提供 `floating`/`inset` 变体或点击折叠轨道。
note.en:
- Breakpoints and resizing are off by default (this demo enables 160–360 DIP resizing and a 64 DIP collapsed width).
- Desktop `collapsed` and narrow-window `Open` are independent; if you hide built-in triggers, supply an external button with `ReturnFocus`.
- Crossing the breakpoint keeps app data, not widget-local scroll positions. `floating`/`inset` variants and click-to-collapse rails are not provided.

name: Header

description.zh: 在内容区顶部展示标题、说明、前导图标和主要操作。
description.en: Display a title, description, leading icon, and primary actions at the top of a page.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

`HeaderLayout` 展示 `Title`、说明 `Description`（原生扩展）、前导内容 `Leading` 和操作区 `Actions`。各区域拥有独立稳定的身份，动态切换前导图标不会重置操作区里的输入控件。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 修改标题、说明，切换前导图标和部件样式，确认右侧输入框草稿不丢失。
2. 点击菜单按钮选择 `Header menu settings`，观察页面更新、菜单关闭与焦点返回。
3. 输入较长标题或切换 RTL，查看换行与对齐效果。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

`HeaderLayout` arranges `Title`, native `Description`, `Leading`, and `Actions`. Each region keeps a stable identity, so toggling leading content does not reset editors inside `Actions`.

### Try the preview

1. Edit the title/description and toggle the leading icon or styles without losing the draft in `Actions`.
2. Open the menu and select `Header menu settings` to see the page update, menu close, and focus return.
3. Try long titles and RTL.

note.zh:
- `HeaderLayout` 默认带有窗口页眉无障碍角色（`ui.RoleBanner`），同一窗口最多保留一个；嵌套实例可调用 `.Role(ui.RoleGroup)` 取消。
- 标题默认为空，不会自动添加首页链接、吸顶定位或移动菜单；如需响应式菜单，请像本示例一样组合 `Sidebar`。
note.en:
- `HeaderLayout` sets the window banner landmark (`ui.RoleBanner`), so a window should have at most one; call `.Role(ui.RoleGroup)` on nested instances.
- Title defaults to empty without automatic home links, sticky positioning, or a built-in mobile menu—compose `Sidebar` when you need a responsive menu.

name: Footer

description.zh: 在页面或内容区底部展示版权说明与次要操作按钮。
description.en: Show explanatory copy and secondary actions at the bottom of a page.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

`FooterLayout` 用 `Text` 展示底部说明文字，用 `Actions` 构建右侧操作区（按钮间距默认 6 DIP，空间不足自动换行）。可通过 `UI` 分别定制 `Root`、`Label` 和 `Actions` 的外观。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 点击 `Review` 和 `Help` 按钮，查看触发次数与状态。
2. 开启「操作区样式」，查看自定义背景、内边距和按钮间距。
3. 输入较长文字或切换 RTL，查看自动换行与对齐变化。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

`FooterLayout` renders copy via `Text` and controls via `Actions` (6 DIP default gap, wrapping when space is tight). Customize `Root`, `Label`, and `Actions` through `UI`.

### Try the preview

1. Click `Review` and `Help` to watch callback counts update.
2. Enable `Action style` to inspect custom background, padding, and spacing.
3. Enter longer text or toggle RTL to inspect wrapping.

note.zh:
- 原生提供简洁的 `Text` 与 `Actions` 分区（默认无顶部边框，内边距 20×12 DIP）；需要多区复杂页脚时可自由组合原生布局。
- 默认带有页脚信息无障碍角色（`ui.RoleContentInfo`），同一窗口最多一个；嵌套实例可调用 `.Role(ui.RoleGroup)` 取消。
note.en:
- Exposes `Text` and `Actions` regions (no default top border, 20×12 DIP padding); compose native layouts for multi-zone footers.
- Sets the window content-info landmark (`ui.RoleContentInfo`), so a window should have at most one; call `.Role(ui.RoleGroup)` on nested instances.

name: FooterColumns

description.zh: 将页脚导航链接按多列栏目整齐排列。
description.en: Organize footer navigation links into responsive columns.

guide.zh:
### 基本用法

为每一列和每个链接项指定唯一 `ID`；列标题用 `Title`，链接项复用 `NavigationItem`。点击时先执行单项 `OnSelect`（可调用 `PreventDefault` 取消），再执行组件级 `OnNavigate`。

### 在预览中试一试

1. 点击 `Examples` 或 `指南` 查看激活高亮与计数（禁用项不可点击）。
2. 开启「取消单项导航」，再次点击确认 `OnNavigate` 被阻止。
3. 调整「栏目最小宽度」、开启「列与链接样式」或切换 RTL，观察多列折行效果。
guide.en:
### Basic usage

Assign unique `ID`s to each column and link. Columns set `Title` and reuse `NavigationItem` for links. Per-item `OnSelect` runs before `OnNavigate` and can call `PreventDefault` to cancel.

### Try the preview

1. Click `Examples` or the guide link to watch active styling and counts (disabled items do nothing).
2. Enable `Cancel selection` and click again to see `OnNavigate` blocked.
3. Adjust column minimum width, toggle custom styles, or switch RTL.

note.zh:
- `MinColumnWidth` 默认 160 DIP（非正值使用默认），长链接文字单行省略。
- 链接项仅读取 `NavigationItem` 的 `ID`、`Label`、`Icon`、`Active`、`Disabled`、`OnSelect`、`UI`、`Style`，子菜单、头像、徽标、提示等字段不生效。
- 原生按 `ID` 回调通知应用，不内置 URL 打开、路由匹配或外链图标。
note.en:
- `MinColumnWidth` defaults to 160 DIP (non-positive uses the default); long link labels truncate on one line.
- Links use only `NavigationItem`'s `ID`, `Label`, `Icon`, `Active`, `Disabled`, `OnSelect`, `UI`, and `Style`; children, avatars, badges, tooltips, and popovers are ignored.
- Reports clicks by `ID` without built-in URL opening, routing, or external-link indicators.
